note: Impact log (decision #76): a dated record of what changed after we published. Only things with a record we can link or show: an official reply, a correction by the county, a question raised in the Assembly (with the Hansard page), a meeting attended, or a resident's account given with consent. Never claim credit for a change we cannot connect to our work; say 'after we published', not 'because of us', unless the record says so.
